resources.string: Add premieres, broadcast changes and streaming platforms to your agenda. An optional AnimeSchedule connection enriches the titles you follow.
Japanese RAW · English SUB and DUB
Paused · the usual agenda remains active
Other announced times remain visible. If your preferred broadcast is missing, the Japanese broadcast is used. These dates do not guarantee availability in your extension.
Sign in or create an AnimeSchedule account.
The guide takes you to the form for connecting Nyanime.
Tap Connect to Nyanime to verify and save the token on your phone. Manual paste is also available.
With this connection disabled or unavailable, the existing agenda continues using the usual catalog and extension data. Previously verified times remain cached briefly during a network outage.
Your token is encrypted on this device and excluded from portable backups. Only catalog IDs are sent; library history, source details and playback URLs stay private.
Use Login to sign in or Sign up to register. If cookie choices appear, confirm with Accept selected.
Sign in with your account or choose Create account.
Complete the form and site verification. If you receive a confirmation email, open it and return here to Sign in.
Enter your email and use the website action. Check your inbox, then return to the sign-in form.
The name is already filled in. Read and accept the site API terms, then tap Create connection.
The token stays hidden. Select the connection to use, then Nyanime will verify it and save it encrypted.
This page keeps its original layout. Return to the form or continue in your browser.
I have a token · Enter manually
No valid token was found. Use the full website and paste it manually.
Open API settings, create an application named Nyanime and copy its Bearer token.

1. Sign in or register.
2. Open your profile settings, then API. Create an application and copy its Bearer token (not an OAuth token).
3. Tap “I copied my token” to paste and verify it.
The original website remains fully accessible. Use your browser if sign-in requires it.
This page is unavailable. Try again or continue in your browser.
The token could not be validated. Copy the application Bearer token from API settings and connect again.
AnimeSchedule requests a pause. Requests will resume automatically; your saved agenda remains available.
This title has no unambiguous verified match on AnimeSchedule. The usual catalog remains available.
AnimeSchedule is currently unreachable. Check your connection and try again. The usual agenda remains available.
AnimeSchedule could not complete this request. We will retry automatically; your usual agenda remains available.
These AnimeSchedule data could not be read. Saved dates and your usual agenda remain available.
The connection could not be completed on this phone. Try again; your usual agenda remains available.
Open Nyanime to view your releases
Your next anime and manga releases from the saved agenda
Optional premieres, RAW/SUB/DUB and changed broadcast dates · guided setup
Add the Releases widget from your launcher widget menu.
